configuration.instructions:
*** Operational Instructions ***
1. Alert when "InteractiveDelayPct" crosses above 90 for any capacity in table sig_capacity_health.
2. Alert when "BackgroundRejectionPct" crosses above 80 for any capacity in table sig_capacity_health.
3. Alert when "CapacityState" becomes "Overloaded" in table sig_capacity_state.
4. When alerting, recommend only the "Notify capacity admin" action. Do not recommend any action that changes a capacity or workspace.
*** Semantic Instructions ***
1. Each capacity is identified by "CapacityId" in sig_capacity_health and sig_capacity_state.
2. "InteractiveDelayPct" above 100 means users already see throttling; 90 is an early warning.
3. "BackgroundRejectionPct" above 100 means background jobs are rejected.
4. The items loading a capacity right now are in sig_capacity_operations: rows for that "CapacityId" with "WindowEndUtc" later than now, summed by "ItemId" on "CapacityUnitMs". Name the top items in the alert. All capacity data is real time.

00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000.description: Sends a notification about the capacity alert to the capacity admin. Notification only; makes no change to the capacity. Runs a Power Automate flow through the act_ops_notify Activator.

parameters.name: CapacityId
parameters.description: CapacityId of the capacity in the alert

parameters.name: CapacityName
parameters.description: CapacityName of the capacity in the alert

parameters.name: CapacitySku
parameters.description: CapacitySku of the capacity in the alert

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: The value that triggered the alert, for example InteractiveDelayPct
